summary:
**ASTRA HEALTH** is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and analysis platform designed to support health management during long-duration space missions.

Spaceflight exposes astronauts to unique health challenges, including microgravity, radiation, isolation, sleep disruption, and changes in physical and mental well-being. ASTRA HEALTH addresses these challenges through an integrated web-based platform that organizes health data, monitors key indicators, identifies unusual changes, and visualizes health trends over time.

The platform also features **ASTRA AI**, an AI assistant designed to help users understand health information, interpret analytical results, and access relevant scientific knowledge. By combining health data analysis with AI-powered explanations, ASTRA HEALTH aims to make complex information easier to understand and support more informed health monitoring.

This project is important because early awareness of potential health changes can help support astronaut well-being, mission safety, and the success of future long-duration space exploration.
details:
ASTRA HEALTH – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring and Analysis System

ASTRA HEALTH is a web-based platform designed to support astronaut health monitoring during long-duration space missions. It addresses health challenges associated with spaceflight, including microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation, sleep disruption, and changes in physical well-being.

The platform organizes health information into an accessible dashboard, allowing users to review key health indicators, observe changes over time, and identify unusual patterns in available measurements. Its AI assistant, ASTRA AI, is designed to help users understand health information, explain analytical results, and access relevant scientific knowledge.

Our project combines AI-assisted development, health data analysis concepts, and a user-friendly interface. We used Google AI Studio to develop the website, while ChatGPT and Claude supported project research, planning, content development, and coding assistance.

ASTRA HEALTH aims to make complex health information easier to understand and support earlier awareness of potential health changes. Its creative approach is the integration of health monitoring, trend visualization, and an AI assistant within one platform specifically designed around the challenges of space exploration.

Our team considered usability, data reliability, scientific accuracy, privacy, and the limitations of AI. The platform is intended as a health-monitoring support concept, not a replacement for professional medical assessment or a clinically validated diagnostic system.
